pr.title: feat(server): user preferences API and ops health check

name_bullet.instructions: Which bullet of the pull request description does this group of changes implement?

criteria.b4: Health checks move from `GET /api/v1/health` to `GET /healthz` on the ops listener (`PORTAL_OPS_ADDR`, default `:9090`)
